title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 320 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 320 - Punishment for Non-compliance with the Provisions of Subsection (7) of Section 221 If any person, without reasonable cause, fails to comply with the directions required under sub-section (7) of section 221, he shall for a specified period which is 1 (one) year may be extended up to such maximum shall be punished with imprisonment up to 1 (one) year or fine or both.
